capabilities: Export Zotero collections, picked items, or authors as .canvas citation maps
Derive reading status from Zotero annotations and read/unread tags
Expand cited works outside the selection into the map
Link paper cards to vault notes via Better BibTeX citation keys or exact note titles
Configure colors, file-name patterns, and grouping options
disambiguation: Not a citation-insertion or bibliography tool; it only exports a read-only visual map of your Zotero library as a canvas file.
extras: Desktop-only by design; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by the Obsidian team. Development/BRAT install is documented; no marketplace install mentioned.
problem: Obsidian Canvas maps have to be built by hand, so there is no quick way to visualize a Zotero library's citation relationships inside a vault.

relations.evidence: Citation Atlas talks to the Zotero Local API on localhost:23119
match by Better BibTeX citation key (Citation Key: in the Extra field)
the Read 2026-01-02 style used by zotero-actions-tags (prefix matching)

summary: Zotero citation-map exporter that writes a .canvas literature map with papers as cards, citation edges, collection groups, and reading-status colors.
